items.name: Crumb-coated pan-fried fish fillet (possibly chicken) with red onion strips
items.preparation: crumb-coated and pan-fried or baked, topped with cooked red onion

items.name: Sliced roast pork loin (possibly turkey breast)
items.preparation: roasted, sliced, with seasoning on the edges

items.name: Cucumber chunks
items.preparation: raw, cut into chunks, with a few red pepper flakes or seasoning bits

items.name: Cooking oil (implied)
items.preparation: used to pan-fry the fish and roast the meat

scale_cues: Large square white dinner plate, about 27-28 cm across. I compared each portion's size to the plate. Melon cubes are about 2.5-3 cm per side. No cutlery or hand was visible.
assumptions: The top protein looks like a breaded white fish fillet but could be breaded chicken.
The sliced meat is assumed to be lean roast pork loin. If it is turkey, the calories would be a little lower.
The pale green chunks with darker skin are assumed to be cucumber, and the paler, smoother cubes are assumed to be honeydew.
About 5 g of cooking oil is assumed for the fried and roasted items.
The small red bits on the fruit and vegetables weigh well under 5 g and were not counted.
